scenes.caption: A canteen robot.
scenes.say: A school canteen robot wants to build a plate. It has lots of food.

scenes.caption: Sweets first!
scenes.say: The robot piles on sweets. Is that a good plate? Not really.

scenes.caption: Big vegetables.
scenes.say: Now it adds lots of fruit and vegetables. They fill a big part of the plate.

scenes.caption: Starchy food.
scenes.say: Next, roti and rice. They give energy to learn and play.

scenes.caption: Protein and dairy.
scenes.say: A smaller share of daal, eggs and yoghurt helps muscles grow.

scenes.caption: A tiny treat.
scenes.say: And one small treat. A little bit is fine.

scenes.caption: Water to drink.
scenes.say: The robot adds a glass of water. Our bodies need water every day.

scenes.caption: A balanced plate!
scenes.say: A balanced plate. Big bread, big vegetables, small sweets. Well done, robot!
